content:
Apple One will become even more useful with iOS 27, as subscribers will benefit from a range of new features across bundled Apple services such as iCloud+ and Apple Music. Below is an introduction to the new features.

One: Get more Apple Intelligence features

iOS 27 brings major Apple Intelligence upgrades, including an all-new Siri AI, powerful editing tools for Apple Photos, enhanced image generation and more.

Although these features will be available to all users for free, some have daily usage caps — and the cap will increase depending on the tier of Apple One plan you subscribe to.

It is not yet clear by how much the AI usage cap will be increased. However, since each Apple One plan includes iCloud+, recent evidence suggests that the usage cap will scale up incrementally with each plan tier.

Two: Four new upgrades for HomeKit Secure Video

HomeKit Secure Video, another iCloud+ benefit, will gain four new features in iOS 27. Apple says:

  • 4K video: "Supported HomeKit Secure Video cameras can now stream and record 4K video"
  • Automatically generated video descriptions: "Users can quickly understand what happens across a series of clips without having to watch each one"
  • Clip search: "Users can easily find what they want to see, such as a package delivery"
  • Highlight reels: "At the top of the search page, the Home app will surface highlight reels that users are most likely to want to watch, helping them quickly catch up on important moments"

Once iOS 27 launches, all Apple One subscribers will be able to use each of these new features. You simply need a compatible smart camera and home hub. My personal recommendations include:

  • Aqara G100 2K security camera: $39, an outstanding value pick
  • eufy 4K security camera: Supports 4K recording at a very reasonable price of just $54

Three: Apple Music improvements

Lastly, Apple Music will also receive a number of new features and improvements with iOS 27.

  • Redesigned artist and album pages
  • Landscape now-playing interface on iPhone
  • AutoMix brings "more immersive, engaging transitions"
  • AutoMix comes to Apple TV and HomePod
  • tvOS 27 supports Hi-Res Lossless audio streaming

In addition, lyrics translation and lyrics pronunciation features will support more languages. Apple says:

Lyrics translation will add seven new language pairs, seamlessly translating the lyrics of users' favourite songs, including English to French, English to German, English to Italian, English to Korean, English to Spanish, French to English, and Japanese to English. […] Lyrics pronunciation, which lets users sing along in another language, will also add five new language pairs, including Arabic to Romanised Arabic, English to Korean characters, English to Katakana, Japanese to Korean characters, and Simplified Chinese to Katakana.

Apple also highlighted a number of important bug fixes, including improved streaming stability, faster loading of the Now Playing interface, and quicker playback startup.

Which Apple One feature in iOS 27 are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments.

Apple One starts at $19.95 per month and includes Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud+ and more.

Featured iPhone accessories

  • AirPods Pro 3 (now just $189, was $249)
  • iPhone MagSafe car mount
  • 10-year battery case for AirTag
  • AirTag 2 (1-pack / 4-pack)
  • 100W USB-C fast-charging power adapter
